scope_out: must not send an email or SMS notification on any state change; must not expose another customer's application; must not show a decision section before the application is decided

operations.text:
1. Define `StatusPill` in `frontend/src/ui/components/StatusPill.tsx` (new): a presentational component rendering the `ApplicationStatus` value (owned by E1-S1's `frontend/src/types/enums.ts`) as a labeled pill, with no fetching and no business logic.
2. Define the `Track` screen in `frontend/src/ui/pages/Track.tsx` (new): fetch the signed-in customer's application via `GET /applications/{application_id}` using the application client from `frontend/src/api/applications.ts` (owned by E4-S3), render the current status with `StatusPill`, list every still-unverified `ApplicationDocument` from the response's `document_checklist` (populated by the verification queue service owned by E6-S1), and render the `decision` block with its reason codes only when `decision` is non-null (produced by the decision service owned by E5-S2) — never before the application is decided, and never dispatching an email or SMS notification.
3. Add one route entry for `Track` to the frontend route registry `frontend/src/ui/routes.tsx` (owned by E1-S1).
4. Append one screen row for `Track` to the customer-facing screen registry `frontend/tests/a11y/registry.ts` (owned by E17-S1) so the screen is covered by the accessibility harness before it lands.
5. Add unit tests in `frontend/tests/unit/Track.test.tsx` (new) covering AC1-AC4: the current status is shown (AC1), every unverified required document is listed (AC2), the decision and its reason codes render once decided (AC3), and no decision section or notification appears before a decision exists (AC4).
